themes.label: Refunds delayed or missing after returns
themes.summary: Android users report that refunds for returned or cancelled orders take weeks or months to arrive, and customer service often gives vague escalation answers or disconnects calls. Several also describe payments being debited for orders that never appear in the app, or orders marked delivered when they were not, which leaves them with no clear path to a refund.
themes.recommendation: Audit the refund and payment-reversal pipeline for Android by reconciling captured payments against order status, flagging orders with a debit but no confirmed order record or with a refund open beyond 14 days, and add an in-app refund status tracker that shows the expected credit date.

themes.label: Delayed orders, refunds, and returns
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS describe long delivery delays, orders cancelled without clear notice, and refunds or return pickups that take weeks or months, with customer service often unreachable or giving conflicting information. Several reviewers say return pickups were scheduled and then missed or cancelled, and some report being charged twice or receiving wrong items before a refund.
themes.recommendation: Audit the order-to-refund pipeline end to end, starting with reviews that cite cancellations and missed return pickups, and add automated status notifications at each stage (dispatched, delayed, cancelled, refund initiated) with a target refund SLA that customer service can see on the case.

themes.label: App crashes or freezes on launch
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android report the H&M app crashing right after opening, hanging on a loading spinner, or freezing when switching to other apps. Many say it worked well previously and broke after a recent update, with some reporting the problem persisting for weeks or months despite reinstalling. A few note the app still sends popup notifications while the app itself will not open.
themes.recommendation: Pull crash and ANR logs segmented by iOS and Android app version (starting with v25.x releases) and by device model and OS, and check whether the launch sequence stalls on a network or remote config call that can be bounded with a timeout and graceful fallback.

themes.label: Redesigned app hard to navigate
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android say the redesign launched around August to September 2024 made the H&M app hard to navigate, with categories, filters, favourites and search buried or missing. Many describe the new look as copying the Zara website, with large fashion-editorial images replacing functional product browsing, and ask for the old design to be restored. A few reviews also report newer breakage such as images not loading, sizes showing as in stock when they are not, and search or cart errors.
themes.recommendation: Run usability testing on the current navigation against the pre-redesign flow for three core tasks (find a category, filter by size and sale, locate favourites), then prioritise restoring category and filter visibility on the home screen and Favourites as a ticket for the next release.

themes.label: App login and password reset failures
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS report being unable to sign in despite entering correct credentials, with the app repeatedly showing wrong email or password errors, freezing on sign-in, or doing nothing when the button is tapped. Many also say password reset emails never arrive from the app, while the website login and reset work fine, and several note the failure persisted through reinstalls and password changes, sometimes with account lockouts for suspicious activity.
themes.recommendation: Investigate the app authentication flow against the web login by pulling logs for failed app sign-ins and reset email sends from the last 12 months, grouped by app version (especially v22 to v26) and OS, to check for credential sync or token issues and for reset emails failing to dispatch; ship a fix and verify with a test matrix covering Android and iOS.

themes.label: Checkout, cart and points failures
themes.summary: Users report that items disappear from the shopping cart, orders fail or leave payment unprocessed, and points or member rewards get reset or go missing, sometimes after reinstalling the app or updating versions. Many say customer service could not resolve these problems, and some report that out-of-stock items were released from the cart while they were still shopping. The complaints span Android and iOS and many app versions, though the mix of praise for the clothing itself is common in the same reviews.
themes.recommendation: Audit the cart and checkout pipeline by reproducing cart item loss, stuck payment states and the order-freeze on confirm across Android and iOS, starting with builds from v22 to v26, and check whether stock reservation releases carts or orders prematurely. Separately, review loyalty points reset and reinstall behaviour, and confirm points are tied to the account rather than the device.

themes.label: Language locked to market region
themes.summary: Users report that the app ties its display language to their selected country or region, so anyone living abroad or who has been auto-assigned a market (often Canada, USA, France or Germany) cannot switch to English or another language they read. Several say the language changed without their consent after an update, and some who set the wrong language could not find a way back, leading to deleted accounts and abandoned purchases.
themes.recommendation: Decouple app language from market selection by adding an in-app language picker in Settings that is independent of region, and audit the auto-assignment logic that sets market and language on first launch and after app updates (v26.31 to v26.38 reports).

themes.label: Favourites list disappearing or failing to load
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android report that saved favourites and shopping bag items vanish after app updates or after the app sits unopened, and some cannot load the favourites section or add new items at all (often with a generic error). Several note the problem has persisted for months or years across many versions, and a few say it makes the app effectively unusable, with some also mentioning a cap on how many items can be favourited.
themes.recommendation: Investigate favourites and bag sync by pulling server-side logs and crash reports for the favourites and bag endpoints, grouped by app version (especially v21.15 to v25.03) and by session timeout behaviour, then add a regression test that verifies favourites persist across app update and cold start.

themes.label: Buggy app, order and delivery issues
themes.summary: Users describe a mix of app bugs (crashes on opening, cart items reappearing, slow performance, lost browsing position, and trouble selecting colours or sizes) and weak order handling, including order tracking that never works, wrong or cancelled orders, slow deliveries, and hard-to-reach customer service. Several reviewers say the problems started after a recent update and some praise the brand or stores while criticising the app specifically.
themes.recommendation: Pull crash and error logs for the last three app releases (especially v23.16 onward and the redesign in v25.x) on iOS and Android, and triage the top cart, checkout, and order-tracking failures into a prioritised bug list with owners and target fix dates.

themes.label: Praise: easy shopping experience
themes.summary: Users in this cluster praise the H&M app as easy to navigate, quick to check out, and enjoyable for buying clothes, with frequent mentions of discounts, promotions, and reliability. A few reviews add small caveats, such as favourited items disappearing and a discount code that cannot be redeemed, but they are isolated rather than a shared complaint.
themes.recommendation: Protect the checkout and navigation flow in regression testing, and separately investigate the two recurring edge cases: favourites being cleared (reproduce on iOS v21.28 and later) and promo codes failing to redeem at checkout.

themes.label: Praise: easy app shopping experience
themes.summary: Most reviews in this French-language iOS cluster praise the H&M app as smooth, clear, and easy to browse, with users enjoying filters, favourites, and fast ordering. Several also praise the clothing quality, style, and prices, so the cluster is mostly positive with little explicit request. A minority of reviews mention crashes, freezing, and failed payments, which is a separate concern mixed into this group.
themes.recommendation: Protect the browsing, filtering, and checkout flow that users praise, and separately pull reviews mentioning freezing, crashes, or payment retries on iOS (v23.37 to v25.50) into their own triage ticket to check for regressions.

themes.label: Praise: H&M value and quality
themes.summary: Most reviews in this cluster are enthusiastic praise for H&M's affordable prices, good quality, trendy styles, and fit, with users calling it a go-to brand. The few lower ratings are not about the products but about post-purchase handling: missing or wrongly delivered items, cancelled orders, slow refunds, and the lack of exchange options, especially for sizing problems on the website.
themes.recommendation: Protect the product and pricing strengths in current messaging, and open an investigation into online order fulfilment and returns by pulling tickets tagged refund, exchange, wrong item, or cancelled order from the last 12 months to size the exchange gap and refund delay issue.

themes.label: Praise: quality clothes at fair prices
themes.summary: Users in this cluster are overwhelmingly praising H&M for clothing that feels high quality for the price, with repeated mentions of good fit, up-to-date styles, and affordability across kids, women's, and men's ranges. A few reviewers also highlight fast delivery, responsive customer service, and sales or loyalty discounts as reasons they keep shopping in the app.
themes.recommendation: Protect the value perception by instrumenting which product attributes (fit, fabric quality, price, sale badges) drive repeat purchases, and surface quality and fit cues like fabric details and fit notes more prominently on product pages to build on this praise.

themes.label: Praise: generic short app reviews
themes.summary: Most of this cluster is very short praise such as "best," "amazing," and "love it," with no specific feature, screen, or request mentioned. The few critical reviews are scattered and unrelated to each other: one says the app is not working on v22.5.2, one is a boycott over the brand's politics, and one reports an ordered item never arriving.
themes.recommendation: Filter the low-rated reviews in this cluster (v22.5.2 "NOT working" and the missing-package complaint) and check crash or login logs for v22.5.2 on iOS, and route the delivery complaint to customer support for order lookup, so the team can confirm whether the app bug is real before treating this cluster as a stable positive baseline.
